mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_subject(user_id,subject_id,preferred_bank_id,sort_order,version) VALUES(#{row.userId},#{row.subjectId},#{row.preferredBankId},#{row.sortOrder},#{row.version}) ON CONFLICT(user_id,subject_id) DO UPDATE SET preferred_bank_id=excluded.preferred_bank_id,sort_order=excluded.sort_order,version=excluded.version

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_favorite(user_id,question_id) VALUES(#{userId},#{questionId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.question_id,q.bank_id,r.stem,r.type,f.created_at,(q.status='ACTIVE' AND b.status='ACTIVE' AND b.publication_status='PUBLISHED' AND s.status='ACTIVE') AS available FROM user_favorite f JOIN question q ON q.id=f.question_id JOIN question_revision r ON r.id=q.current_revision_id JOIN question_bank b ON b.id=q.bank_id JOIN subject s ON s.id=b.subject_id WHERE f.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC,f.question_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
